sloka: वासम् चक्रुर् मुनि गणाः शोणा कूले समाहिताः ।ते अस्तम् गते दिनकरे स्नात्वा हुत हुताशनाः ॥१-३१-२०॥
transliteration: vāsam cakrur muni gaṇāḥ śoṇā kūle samāhitāḥ ।te astam gate dinakare snātvā huta hutāśanāḥ ॥1-31-20॥

translations.english: The sages who possessed great splendour bathed and offered oblations to fire at sunset and sat in front of Viswamitra.
